Unit: one representative genome per species; boxes show the median and quartiles, dots are genomes. Use the tabs to switch between phylum, subphylum and class.

## Genome size and gene number

```{python}
fig("F03_genome_size_vs_genes", "Genome size against protein-coding gene number (log-log).", "70%")
fig("F02_gene_count", "Protein-coding genes per genome (log scale).")
fig("F02b_genome_size", "Genome size per genome (log scale).")
```

Gene number scales with genome size within each lineage, but lineages differ in intercept (gene density, intron content and repeat content). Compaction and expansion are examined as hypotheses in the [atlas](https://github.com/stajichlab/BFD_dashboard/blob/main/docs/summary_atlas/H2b_compaction_extremes.md).

## Protein length and composition

```{python}
fig("F04_protein_length", "Mean protein length per genome.")
fig("F05b_gc", "Genome GC content.")
```

Mean protein length is sensitive to gene-model quality (partial and fused models); see the [H1 quality page](https://github.com/stajichlab/BFD_dashboard/blob/main/docs/summary_atlas/H1_quality.md).
